panels.title: Numeric device observations — acceptance remains partial

options.content:
Fresh HTTP responses do not prove fresh source samples. Check response and family status first, including media_progress and last_listener_departure. Missing or stale sources are unavailable; gaps are never zero. Counts are raw wrapping gauges; counter derivatives remain unsupported even with boot metadata. Codec progress uses the last measured window.

Media publication and encoded frame age use guarded device receipts. Last-listener panels describe the latest completed listener, not live listeners; their media age is recorded at departure and does not age with the host. Wi-Fi generation is an invalidation token, not a disconnect count. Two anonymous slots expose MP3, FLAC and WAV listener observations. Writing values are sampled elapsed wall time and media age; ready values are recorded at completion and never extrapolated. Idle is known inactive; unavailable is unknown. Each slot expires from its own sample timestamp even if HTTP stays fresh. Slot generations are gauges, never counters. Unavailable: complete live task stacks and measured active buffer settings. Live-listener sampling, cleanup and reuse were verified on the device; playback reliability remains a separate release gate. Inspect loopback /identity for boot/build/settings freshness. Revision comparisons need matched workload and input provenance. This dashboard alone does not establish live device acceptance.

panels.title: Response freshness (1 = available)
panels.description: Latest validated response passes the host freshness gate. 0 means unavailable; absent means collector/scrape unavailable. This does not prove source freshness.

panels.title: Response age (seconds)
panels.description: Host monotonic seconds since last validated response. Absent until a valid response exists.

panels.title: Family freshness (1 = available)
panels.description: Independent capture, encoder, loss, media_progress and last_listener_departure freshness gates. 0 means absent/stale. Source series disappear when unavailable.

panels.title: Family acquisition age (seconds)
panels.description: Age of the original family sample, including host elapsed time. Fresh HTTP alone cannot refresh an old observation.

panels.title: Identity metadata freshness (1 = available)
panels.description: Boot, build ELF hash and allowlisted settings present in a fresh validated response. Fixed kind labels only. Values and operator device ID are in loopback /identity; neither proves authentication or allows host counter rates.

panels.title: Capture read PCM frames (raw count)
panels.description: Raw wrapping u32 count immediately after reads, before drops and settling. Not publication throughput. No boot continuity or counter rate is inferred.

panels.title: Capture queue overflows (raw count)
panels.description: Raw wrapping u32 capture queue overflow count; resets and wraps are not interpreted.

panels.title: Capture software-dropped PCM frames (raw count)
panels.description: Raw wrapping u32 software-dropped PCM frame count, separate from queue overflows.

panels.title: Capture read errors (raw count)
panels.description: Raw wrapping u32 read error count.

panels.title: Capture restarts (raw count)
panels.description: Raw wrapping u32 capture restart count; does not identify device boots.

panels.title: Internal free memory (bytes)
panels.description: Capture sample of internal free bytes; not a minimum or allocation guarantee.

panels.title: Internal largest block (bytes)
panels.description: Largest internal free block at capture observation time; separate from total free bytes.

panels.title: PSRAM free memory (bytes)
panels.description: Capture sample of free PSRAM bytes; not internal heap or a minimum.

panels.title: Encoder progress (codec frames / window)
panels.description: Codec frames encoded within the measured window. Window gauge, not a cumulative counter or PCM frame count.

panels.title: Encoder window duration (seconds)
panels.description: Measured encoder window duration in seconds; unavailable until a window is observed.

panels.title: Encoder progress (codec frames / second)
panels.description: Measured window codec frames divided by positive window seconds. Not audio real-time ratio; codec frame size is not assumed.

panels.title: Encoder maximum encode time (seconds)
panels.description: Maximum encode wall duration within the last measured window, in seconds.

panels.title: Encoder task runtime (seconds / window)
panels.description: Task runtime within the encoder window, including charged interrupts. Absent if runtime is invalid; not CPU utilization.

panels.title: Encoder runtime validity (1 = valid)
panels.description: Runtime validity for the encoder observation. 0 does not mean zero runtime.

panels.title: Telemetry dropped records (raw count)
panels.description: Raw wrapping queue dropped-record count by loss family. Any loss prevents a complete event census.

panels.title: Telemetry loss observed (1 = loss)
panels.description: Retained loss flag by listener/encoder loss family. 0 means no reported queue loss in this observation, not proof of complete streaming health.

panels.title: Internal region low-water sums (bytes)
panels.description: Sum of independently recorded internal region minima. Not a simultaneous heap minimum; bytes, raw source gauge.

panels.title: PSRAM region low-water sums (bytes)
panels.description: Sum of independently recorded PSRAM region minima. Not a simultaneous heap minimum; bytes, raw source gauge.

panels.title: Encoder measured stack headroom (bytes)
panels.description: Measured encoder stack free watermark in the last window. Zero is a valid measured value; null stays unavailable.

panels.title: Metrics owner measured stack headroom (bytes)
panels.description: Measured metrics-owner stack free watermark at each loss-family receipt. These are separate observations of the same owner, not separate tasks. Zero is valid; null stays unavailable.

panels.title: Encoder raw reads (PCM frames / window)
panels.description: PCM frames read from the raw ring during the measured encoder window. Not codec frames or publication throughput.

panels.title: Encoder raw overruns (count / window)
panels.description: Raw ring overruns during the measured encoder window. Window gauge, not a cumulative counter.

panels.title: Encoder resets (count / window)
panels.description: Encoder resets during the measured window. Window gauge; does not identify device boots.

panels.title: Accepted PCM frames (source generation)
panels.description: Accepted PCM frames in the source generation. Requires a fresh accepted receipt; not capture reads.

panels.title: Published raw PCM frames (source generation)
panels.description: Committed raw-ring PCM frames in the source generation. Requires a fresh publication receipt.

panels.title: Encoded publication sequence
panels.description: Latest encoded frame sequence in its generation; may restart after reset. Requires fresh production and matching raw generation and operator epoch.

panels.title: Encoded frame age (seconds)
panels.description: Actual encoded production age plus host acquisition age. Absent without fresh production and matching raw generation and operator epoch; not a live listener age.

panels.title: Encoding backlog (PCM frames)
panels.description: Raw committed frames minus encoded source-end PCM frames, only with matching generations and fresh raw and encoded receipts.

panels.title: Last completed listener bytes sent
panels.description: Bytes sent by the latest completed listener receipt; not live. Unavailable when the departure family expires.

panels.title: Last completed listener maximum frame write (seconds)
panels.description: Maximum whole-frame write duration from the latest completed listener receipt; not live.

panels.title: Last completed listener recorded media age (seconds)
panels.description: Last frame media age recorded by the latest completed listener receipt; not live. This value does not grow with host time.

panels.title: Last completed listener stack headroom (bytes)
panels.description: Measured stack free watermark from the latest completed listener receipt; not live. Zero is valid.

panels.title: Wi-Fi connected (1 = connected)
panels.description: Latest response network state. Missing optional network data stays unavailable; connection alone does not prove audio delivery.

panels.title: Wi-Fi disconnects (raw count)
panels.description: Raw wrapping u32 disconnect count from the latest response. No derivative or boot continuity is inferred.

panels.title: Wi-Fi generation token
panels.description: Network invalidation generation token from the latest response. It is not a disconnect count; it saturates at u32::MAX, where network state is unavailable.

panels.title: Listener slot availability
panels.description: Known slot observation and HTTP are fresh. Zero means unknown; idle is available.

panels.title: Listener slot occupied
panels.description: One means waiting, writing or ready; zero means known idle. Missing means unknown.

panels.title: Listener slot generation
panels.description: Anonymous occupant generation changes on reuse. Never use derivatives.

panels.title: Listener sample age
panels.description: Source sample age plus host elapsed time; independent of HTTP freshness.

panels.title: Listener frame media age
panels.description: Writing: sampled pending-frame age. Ready: recorded completed-write age; never extrapolated.

panels.title: Listener payload write wall time
panels.description: Writing: sampled elapsed payload-write time. Ready: recorded completed duration. Includes scheduling and socket work; not TCP blocked-time alone.

panels.title: HTTP task stack free watermark
panels.description: Measured HTTP task stack free watermark bytes in the fresh response. Zero is valid; null or stale response stays unavailable.
